candidates.headline: Buccaneers extend Baker Mayfield: Key intel and a grade
candidates.description: Why did Mayfield change his mind about a negotiating deadline, and what does it mean for other QBs?

candidates.headline: Bucs, Baker Mayfield agree to 3-year extension, sources say
candidates.description: The Buccaneers and quarterback Baker Mayfield have agreed to a three-year, $165 million extension, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

candidates.headline: With deal done, Donald '100% committed' to Rams' title chase
candidates.description: Aaron Donald, 35, a three-time Defensive Player of the Year and an eight-time first-team All-Pro, formally returned from retirement on Sunday, signing a one-year, $20 million contract with the Los Angeles Rams.
